46400.commentary: (DNa) pītipharaṇat'ādīsu pītiṃ pharamānā uppajjatī'ti dvīsu jhānesu paññā pītipharaṇatā nāma.

examples.text: pañc'aṅgiko sammāsamādhi, pītipharaṇatā, sukhapharaṇatā, cetopharaṇatā, ālokapharaṇatā, paccavekkhaṇanimittaṃ. ime pañca dhammā bhāvetabbā.

46401.meaning1: feeding on delight; feasting on bliss; indulging in joy

examples.text: susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, yesaṃ no n'atthi kiñcanaṃ, pītibhakkhā bhavissāma, devā ābhassarā yathā.
te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhecarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.
pītisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. pītimanassa kāyo'pi passambhati, cittam'pi passambhati.
kāmaṃ kāmayamānassa, tassa ce taṃ samijjhati, addhā pītimano hoti, laddhā macco yadicchati.

46403.meaning1: flavour of delight; juice of joy

examples.text: pavivekarasaṃ pitvā, rasaṃ upasamassa ca, niddaro hoti nippāpo, dhammapītirasaṃ pivaṃ.

46404.meaning1: which generates joy (for); which gives delight (to); which makes (me) happy

examples.text: idañ'hi taṃ jetavanaṃ, isisaṅghanisevitaṃ, āvutthaṃ dhammarājena, pītisañjananaṃ mama.

46405.meaning1: delight as an element of awakening; joy as a factor of enlightenment
46405.commentary: (DNa) pītisambojjh'aṅgassa atthi, bhikkhave, pītisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā, tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā saṃvattatī'ti evaṃ uppādo hoti. tattha pīti'y'eva pītisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā nāma. tassā uppādakamanasikāro yonisomanasikāro nāma.

examples.text: pītisambojjh'aṅgo tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhuno bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. pītimanassa kāyo'pi passambhati, cittam'pi passambhati.
yasmiñ'ca kho, bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo vīriyasambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya.

46406.meaning1: serving as a basis for delight as an element of awakening; which supports joy as a factor of enlightenment

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, pītisambojjh'aṅgaṭṭhānīyā dhammā. tattha yonisomanasikārabahulīkāro, ayam'āhāro anuppannassa vā pītisambojjh'aṅgassa uppādāya, uppannassa vā pītisambojjh'aṅgassa bhāvanāya pāripūriyā.

46407.meaning1: filled with delight; accompanied by heartfelt joy
46407.commentary: (ADHa) pītittike pītiyā saha ek'uppād'ādibhāvaṃ gatā'ti pītisahagatā, pītisampayuttā'ti attho.

examples.text: yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti, upekkhako satimā sukhavihārī'ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato pītisahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

46409.meaning1: delight and ease; joy and happiness
46409.commentary: (VINa) pītisukhan'ti ettha pinayatī'ti pīti, sā sampiyāyanalakkhaṇā kāyacittapīnanarasā, pharaṇarasā vā, odagyapaccupaṭṭhānā. sukhanaṃ sukhaṃ, suṭṭhu vā khādati khanati ca kāyacitt'ābādhan'ti sukhaṃ, taṃ sātalakkhaṇaṃ, sampayuttakānaṃ upabrūhanarasaṃ, anuggahapaccupaṭṭhānaṃ.

examples.text: bhikkhu imam'eva kāyaṃ vivekajena pītisukhena abhisandeti parisandeti paripūreti parippharati n'āssa kiñci sabbāvato kāyassa vivekajena pītisukhena apphuṭaṃ hoti
yaṃ vat'āhaṃ aññesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu okāsakammamattam'pi n'ālatthaṃ taṃ me idaṃ samaṇena gotamena okāsakammaṃ katan'ti. attamano pamudito udaggo pītisomanassajāto bhagavantaṃ pañhaṃ apucchi.
tena sudaṃ, bhante, devatā tāvatiṃsā attamanā honti pamuditā pītisomanassajātā dibbā vata bho kāyā paripūrenti, hāyanti asurakāyā'ti
pahūtaputto bhavatī tathāvidho, parosahassañ'ca bhavanti atrajā, sūrā ca vīrā ca amittatāpanā, gihissa pītiṃjananā piyaṃvadā.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

ambho purisa, ayaṃ tittak'ālābu visena saṃsaṭṭho, sace ākaṅkhasi piva. tassa te pivato c'eva nacchādessati vaṇṇena'pi gandhena'pi rasena'pi, pītvā ca pana maraṇaṃ vā nigacchasi maraṇamattaṃ vā dukkhan'ti.

te diṭṭh'eva dhamme sandiṭṭhikaṃ sippaphalaṃ upajīvanti, te tena attānaṃ sukhenti pīnenti, mātāpitaro sukhenti pīnenti, puttadāraṃ sukhenti pīnenti, mitt'āmacce sukhenti pīnenti, samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddh'aggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhapenti sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikaṃ.

46418.grammar: imp, reflx 3rd sg of pīyati, pass, intrans

examples.text: disvāna yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca, ito, bho sāriputta, payo, pīyataṃ tāva bhattassa kālo bhavissatī'ti.
disvāna yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ etadavoca, ito, bho sāriputta, payo, pīyataṃ tāva bhattassa kālo bhavissatī'ti.
kaṇḍuppaṭicchādi nāma yassa adhonābhi ubbhajāṇumaṇḍalaṃ kaṇḍu vā pīḷakā vā assāvo vā thullakacchu vā ābādho, tassa paṭicchādan'atthāya.

cuṇṇakamakkhitan'ti sāsapakakkena mukhapīḷak'ādīni nīharitvā loṇamattikāya duṭṭhalohitaṃ viliyāpetvā tilapiṭṭhena lohitaṃ pasādetvā haliddiyā vaṇṇaṃ sampādetvā cuṇṇakagaṇḍikāya mukhaṃ paharanti, ten'esa ativiya virocati. taṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.
vaṭṭani'r'iva koṭar'ohitā, majjhe pubbuḷakā sāssukā, pīḷakoḷikā c'ettha jāyati, vividhā cakkhuvidhā ca piṇḍitā.
kiṃsu tassa mahabbhayan'ti kiṃ lokassa bhayaṃ mahabbhayaṃ pīḷanaṃ ghaṭṭanaṃ upaddavo upasaggoti, kiṃsu tassa mahabbhayaṃ.

yathā, mahārāja, atipavaratāya dibbaṃ vanamūlaṃ gahitam'pi hatthapāse ṭhitānaṃ parajanānaṃ na dassayati, agado atijaccatāya pīḷāya samugghātako rogānaṃ antakaro, aggi atijotitāya ḍahati, udakaṃ atisītatāya nibbāpeti, padumaṃ parisuddhatāya na upalimpati vārikaddamena

dhaññaṃ yebhuyyena attano gharaṃ pavesetvā appakaṃ rājakule paveseti. kiṃ brāhmaṇagahapatikānaṃ na pīḷaṃ akāsī'ti ca vutto, āma, mahārāja, imasmiṃ vāre khettāni mandasassāni ahesuṃ, tasmā apīḷentassa me gaṇhato na bahuṃ jātan'ti evaṃ brāhmaṇagahapatike nissāya rājānaṃ vilumpati.
kadā iṇ'aṭṭo'va daliddako nidhiṃ, ārādhayitvā dhanikehi pīḷito, tuṭṭho bhavissaṃ adhigamma sāsanaṃ, mah'esino taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
maccujarāy'upaddutan'ti maraṇena c'eva jarāya ca pīḷitaṃ

46428.meaning1: is hurt; tormented; is oppressed; is molested

examples.text: ruppanti rūpesu janā pamattā'ti. ruppantī'ti ruppanti kuppanti pīḷiyanti ghaṭṭayanti, byādhitā domanassitā honti.

46429.meaning1: is hurt; tormented; is oppressed; is molested

examples.text: so kāmasallena ca sokasallena ca viddho, ruppati kuppati ghaṭṭīyati pīḷīyati byādhito domanassito hotī'ti, sallaviddho'va ruppati.
kismiṃ sati kena kāraṇena loko vihaññati pīḷīyati bādhīyatī'ti ayañ'h'ettha adhippāyo.

46432.meaning1: having hurt; having harmed; having tortured (somebody with)
46432.meaning2: having oppressed, having molested, having subjugated
46432.commentary: (MNt) pīḷetvā'ti viheṭhetvā paṭighāṭan'ādivasena ucchutelayant'ādayo viya ucchutil'ādike vibādhetvā.

examples.text: usulomavatthusmiṃ kāraṇiko'ti rāj'āparādhike anekāhi kāraṇāhi pīḷetvā avasāne kaṇḍena vijjhitvā māraṇakapuriso. so kira amukasmiṃ padese viddho maratī'ti ñatvā'va vijjhati.

46440.meaning1: refuse remover; garbage man; dustbin man; scavenger

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.

46441.meaning1: name of a young Mallan man

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante, santena vata, bhante, pabbajitā vihārena viharanti.

46442.meaning1: family of refuse removers; family of scavengers

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nīce kule paccājāto hoti, caṇḍālakule vā venakule vā nesādakule vā rathakārakule vā pukkusakule vā dalidde app'annapānabhojane kasiravuttike, yattha kasirena ghāsacchādo labbhati.

46443.meaning1: belonging to a family of refuse removers; belonging to a family of scavengers

examples.text: āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā venakulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā, sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontū'ti.
jāti nāma dve jātiyo, hīnā ca jāti ukkaṭṭhā ca jāti. hīnā nāma jāti, caṇḍālajāti, venajāti, nesādajāti, rathakārajāti, pukkusajāti. esā hīnā nāma jāti.

46445.meaning1: story of Pukkusa the young Mallan

examples.text: upako palagaṇḍo ca, pukkusāti ca te tayo, bhaddiyo khaṇḍadevo ca, bāhuraggi ca siṅgiyo. te hitvā mānusaṃ dehaṃ, dibbayogaṃ upaccagun'ti.
paṇḍito, bhikkhave, pukkusāti kulaputto paccapādi dhammass'ānudhammaṃ, na ca maṃ dhamm'ādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi.

46447.meaning1: female refuse remover; dustbin woman; scavenger

examples.text: so brāhmaṇiṃ'y'eva gacchati, na khattiyiṃ na vessiṃ na suddiṃ na caṇḍāliṃ na nesādiṃ na veniṃ na rathakāriṃ na pukkusiṃ gacchati, na gabbhiniṃ gacchati, na pāyamānaṃ gacchati, na anutuniṃ gacchati.
evaṃ tasmiṃ puggale āghāto paṭivinetabbo. samantapāsādikaṃ, āvuso, puggalaṃ āgamma cittaṃ pasīdati.
katamo ca, bhikkhave, bhārahāro? puggalo tissa vacanīyaṃ. yv'āyaṃ āyasmā evaṃnāmo evaṃgotto. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhārahāro.

46449.meaning2: ?? illuminating the function of the person

46450.meaning1: who knows people; who is familiar with individuals; (comm) knowing who to associate with

examples.text: satta sappurisadhammā, idh'āvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca.

46452.meaning1: Book 4 of the Abhidhamma; Designation of Individuals

46454.meaning1: designation of individuals; description of people
46454.commentary: (DNa) puggalapaṇṇattīsū'ti lokavohāravasena satto puggalo naro poso'ti evaṃ paññāpetabbāsu lokapaññattīsu. buddhānañ'hi dve kathā sammutikathā, paramatthakathā'ti poṭṭhapādasutte (dī. ni. aṭṭha. 1.439-443) vitthāritā. (DNt) puggalapaṇṇattīsū'ti puggalānaṃ paññāpanesu. guṇavisesavasena aññam'aññaṃ asaṅkarato ṭhapanesu. lokavohāravasenā'ti lokasammutivasena.

examples.text: ubhatobhāgavimutto paññāvimutto kāyasakkhī diṭṭhippatto saddhāvimutto dhamm'ānusārī saddh'ānusārī. etadānuttariyaṃ, bhante, puggalapaṇṇattīsu.

46457.meaning1: who has faith in an individual; who has confidence in a single person
46457.commentary: (ANa) puggalappasannānan'ti puggaliyappasādena samannāgatānaṃ upāsakānaṃ jīvako komārabhacco aggo'ti dasseti.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ puggalappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ jīvako komārabhacco.

46458.meaning1: faith in a (single) person; confidence in an individual

examples.text: saddhammaṃ asuṇanto saddhammā parihāyati. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamo ādīnavo puggalappasāde.

46459.meaningLit: discourse on faith in a person

46464.meaning1: collection of bones (of a single) person
46464.commentary: (ADht) ekassa puggalassa aṭṭhisañcayo aṭṭhisamūho ekena kappena pabbatasamo rāsi siyā.

examples.text: ekass'ekena kappena, puggalass'aṭṭhisañcayo, siyā pabbatasamo rāsi, iti vuttaṃ mah'esinā.

46469.meaning1: proponent of the doctrine that the individual exists

examples.text: evaṃ ucchedavādimhi pahonte sassatavādī, puggalavādimhi pahonte suññatavādī, suññatavādimhi pahonte puggalavādī'ti evaṃ ṭhān'āṭhāne na saṇṭhāti nāma.
catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena āraddhacittā bhikkhū pabbājenti, upasampādenti bhikkhubhāvāya. api ca m'ettha puggalavemattatā viditā'ti.

46472.meaning1: disrespect towards a person; personal contempt
46472.commentary: (VIN 2.5.6.4) puggal'ānādariyaṃ nāma upasampannena paññattena vuccamāno ayaṃ ukkhittako vā vambhito vā garahito vā, imassa vacanaṃ akataṃ bhavissatī'ti anādariyaṃ karoti, āpatti pācittiyassa.

examples.text: anādariyaṃ nāma dve anādariyāni, puggal'ānādariyañ'ca dhamm'ānādariyañ'ca.

46473.commentary: (VIN) puggalikenā'ti ekāya bhikkhuniyā, na saṅghassa, na gaṇassa.

examples.text: puggalike puggalikasaññī aññassa puggalike, āpatti dukkaṭassa. attano puggalike anāpatti.

puccha maṃ sabhiya pañhaṃ, yaṃ kiñci manas'icchasi, tassa tass'eva pañhassa, ahaṃ antaṃ karomi te'ti.
pucchaka, sammajjanī padīpo ca, udakaṃ āsanena ca, uposathassa etāni, pubbakaraṇan'ti vuccati.
examples.source: VIN PAT PK saṅghuposatha pubbakaraṇādi vidhi

examples.text: siyā kho pana bhikkhave ekabhikkhuss'āpi kaṅkhā vā vimati vā buddhe vā dhamme vā saṅghe vā magge vā paṭipadāya vā pucchatha bhikkhave mā pacchā vippaṭisārino ahuvattha
anejaṃ mūladassāviṃ, atthi pañhena āgamaṃ, kiṃ nissitā isayo manujā, khattiyā brāhmaṇā devatānaṃ, yaññam'akappayiṃsu puthū'dha loke, pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ.

parikappe na saṇṭhātī'ti idaṃ pañhapucchane'pi pañhakathane'pi labbhati. kathaṃ? ekacco hi, pañhaṃ pucchissāmī'ti kaṇṭhaṃ sodheti, so itarena, idaṃ nāma tvaṃ pucchissasī'ti vutto ñātabhāvaṃ ñatvā, na etaṃ, aññaṃ pucchissāmī'ti vadati.

46486.grammar: ind, adv, comp, dat sg of pucchanattha

examples.text: yaṃ jātaṃ taṃ saṅghamajjhe pucchante santaṃ atthī'ti vattabbaṃ asantaṃ n'atthī'ti vattabbaṃ
cirarattaṃ vat'ātāpī, dhammaṃ anuvicintayaṃ, samaṃ cittassa n'ālatthaṃ, pucchaṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇe.

46489.meaning1: sequence of a sutta based on a question
46489.meaning2: sequence of meaning in a sutta based on a question asked
46489.commentary: (DNt) anusandhānaṃ anusandhi, pucchāya kato anusandhi pucch'ānusandhi. atha vā anusandhayatī'ti anusandhi, pucchā anusandhi etassā'ti pucch'ānusandhi. pucchāya anusandhiyatīti vā pucch'ānusandhi.

examples.text: tattha, evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, siyā nu kho, bhante, bahiddhā asati paritassanā'ti? siyā bhikkhū'ti bhagavā avocā'ti (ma. ni. 1.242). evaṃ pucchantānaṃ vissajjitasuttavasena pucch'ānusandhi veditabbo.

46490.meaning1: (of a discourse's origin) on account of a question
46490.meaning2: sutta delivered as the result of a question
46490.commentary: (DNt) pucchāya vaso pucchāvaso, so etassa atthi yathāvuttanayenā'ti pucchāvasiko.

examples.text: evaṃ puṭṭhena bhagavatā yāni kathitāni bojjhaṅgasaṃyutt'ādīni, yāni vā pan'aññāni'pi devatāsaṃyutta-mārasaṃyutta-brahmasaṃyutta-sakkapañha-cūḷavedalla-mahāvedalla-sāmaññaphala-āḷavaka-sūciloma-kharalomasuttādīni, tesaṃ pucchāvasiko nikkhepo.
puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ channaṃ kañci'd'eva desaṃ, sace āyasmā channo okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā'ti. pucch'āvuso sāriputta, sutvā vedissāmā'ti.
sādhu, bhante'ti kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā bhagavantaṃ uttariṃ pañhaṃ pucchi
itthiyā'pi purisassa'pi nāmam'pi gottam'pi pucchitabbaṃ ahosi, tena pucchiṃ. gāmassa'pi nigamassa'pi nāmam'pi maggam'pi pucchitabbaṃ ahosi, tena pucchin'ti.
kassako paṭijānāsi, na ca passāma te kasiṃ, kasiṃ no pucchito brūhi, yathā jānemu te kasiṃ.
aniṭṭhurī ananugiddho, anejo sabbadhī samo, tam'ānisaṃsaṃ pabrūmi, pucchito avikampinaṃ.

46494.meaning1: should be asked; could be asked
46494.meaning2: should be asked, should be questioned

examples.text: evañ'ca kho eso, bhikkhu, pañho pucchitabbo
anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā pañho pucchitabbo, cattāro'me, āvuso, vohārā tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katame cattāro?
kā upanisā savanāyā'ti iti ce, bhikkhave, pucchitāro assu, te evam'assu vacanīyā, yāva'd'eva dvayatānaṃ dhammānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ ñāṇāyā'ti. kiñ'ca dvayataṃ vadetha?

46497.meaning1: wanting to ask; wishing to enquire

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, acelo kassapo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, na kho pana mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ bahu'd'eva pucchitu'kāmā'ti. puccha, kassapa, yadākaṅkhasī'ti.

46498.meaning1: to ask; to enquire; to question (somebody about)

examples.text: kaṅkhī vecikicchī āgamaṃ, pañhe pucchituṃ abhikaṅkhamāno, tes'antakaro bhavāhi pañhe me puṭṭho, anupubbaṃ anudhammaṃ byākarohi me.

46499.meaning1: having asked; having enquired; having questioned (somebody about)

examples.text: kiṃ bhante avelāya ayyā āgatā'ti pucchitvā ādito paṭṭhāya kathesuṃ
satthā mūlasiriṃ āmantetvā, jānāsi etan'ti pucchitvā, na jānāmī'ti vutte, pitā te ānandaseṭṭhī'ti vatvā asaddahantaṃ, ānandaseṭṭhi puttassa te pañca mahānidhiyo ācikkhāhī'ti ācikkhāpetvā saddahāpesi
